outer_envelope_note: The stale 801-frame/194427-particle/34-contact wrapper fields are documented and excluded from actual F2 401-frame/418104-particle/17-contact review counts.
review_method: Personally viewed every published contact sheet and each specified event keyframe with view_image; visual screen only, with no numerical-precision or physical-truth certification.
visual_observations: All 17 contact sheets are populated with stable isometric and transverse-side views; the initial moving orange body, gray tray/boundary, and blue fluid are legible.

The sequence shows initial motion and splash, coherent run-out over the tray, broad open-rim spreading, and a settled late-stage film/run-out without blank pages, abrupt truncation, gross render loss, or unexplained missing render files.

Detached blue splash points are visible above and around the moving body during the early event; these are recorded as visible observations only and are not used to reinterpret producer-attested UID omissions.

The later views show a broad blue sheet and edge spill consistent with the declared open-rim geometry. No obvious whole-domain explosion or severe visible through-bed/through-wall penetration is apparent in the displayed views.
Because this is an open-rim case and Root1266 records unknown final fluid UID locations/states/causes, no strict containment or closed-fluid claim is made.
